prediction.likelyOutcome: McCarthy's lien-foreclosure/breach claim is likely to be substantially cut down at trial given its own admitted invoicing errors, the unauthorized Swartout Pit change order, and the unlicensed subcontractor issue, meaning Stark probably owes little or nothing beyond what he already paid; Stark is likely to recover at least the quantified wrongful-lien costs ($7,596.70) and has a fighting chance at the larger, currently unquantifiable opportunity-cost damages tied to the frozen collateral account, while his ICPA claim is the weakest piece of his case.

outcome.description: After a seven-day bench trial the district court dismissed McCarthy's lien-foreclosure and contract claims and awarded Stark $51,760.83 on his breach-of-contract counterclaim (completion cost of $202,090.81 less $150,329.98 unpaid contract balance) plus $34,100.46 in ICPA damages (total $85,861.29), and $129,434 in attorney fees and $4,535.33 costs. The Idaho Supreme Court affirmed in full and awarded Stark fees on appeal.
